gws-admin-reports.description: Admin Reports: lists, watches, and stops audit-log streams; gets customer and user usage reports. Use for login audits, admin actions, or domain usage stats.
gws-admin-reports.rationale: Leads with audit-log and usage-report nouns plus the CRUD verbs (list/watch/stop/get), using admin-specific triggers (login audits, admin actions, domain stats) that don't collide with gws-events subscriptions.

gws-calendar.description: Google Calendar: shows agenda, creates, updates, deletes, and moves events; checks free/busy. Use for scheduling meetings, editing appointments, or checking availability.
gws-calendar.rationale: Leads with calendar/agenda/event nouns and concrete CRUD verbs plus free/busy availability, distinct from Meet rooms and Tasks to-dos.

gws-chat.description: Google Chat: sends, reads, and searches Chat-space messages, DMs, and threads; creates, lists, updates, deletes spaces; manages members. Use for Chat — not email.
gws-chat.rationale: Leads with distinctive Chat-space/DM/thread nouns and the required send verb, covers space CRUD and member management, and draws the boundary against Gmail.

gws-classroom.description: Google Classroom: creates, updates, deletes courses; enrolls students/teachers; sets coursework, grades, topics, announcements. Use for class rosters or assignments.
gws-classroom.rationale: Leads with distinctive Classroom nouns (courses, rosters, coursework, grades) and names the full CRUD plus enrollment surface; no helper-shortcut verbs were required.

gws-docs.description: Google Docs: creates, reads, writes, edits, appends, and batch-updates Doc documents. Use for drafting or updating Doc text — not Sheets, Slides, or Forms.
gws-docs.rationale: Leads with the distinctive "Doc documents" noun and concrete CRUD verbs (create/read/edit/append/batch-update) plus the required "write", while explicitly excluding sibling Sheets/Slides/Forms.

gws-drive.description: Google Drive: uploads, downloads, copies, moves, shares, deletes files, folders, shared drives; sets permissions, comments, revisions. Use for Drive storage, folders, or sharing.
gws-drive.rationale: Leads with distinctive Drive nouns (files, folders, shared drives) and concrete CRUD verbs plus permissions/comments/revisions, covering the required upload verb while staying under 180 chars and distinct from Docs/Sheets/Slides.

gws-events.description: Workspace Events: subscribes to, renews, reactivates, lists, and deletes Calendar/Chat/Drive change subscriptions. Use to watch for changes or revive a suspended subscription.
gws-events.rationale: Leads with the distinctive "event subscriptions / watch for changes" boundary so it fires on subscription management rather than colliding with the calendar/chat/drive resource skills, while covering create/list/delete/reactivate CRUD.

gws-forms.description: Google Forms: creates, reads, edits, and publishes surveys and quizzes; retrieves form responses and sets response watches. Use for building or reading form submissions.
gws-forms.rationale: Leads with distinctive Forms nouns (surveys, quizzes, form responses) and names every API method's CRUD verb while staying under 180 characters and distinct from Sheets/Docs.

gws-gmail.description: Gmail: sends, reads, replies, reply-alls, forwards email; triages inbox, watches new mail; creates drafts, labels, threads. Use for composing, replying, or inbox — not Chat.
gws-gmail.rationale: Front-loads the seven helper verbs plus draft/label/thread CRUD, leads with email-specific nouns, and disambiguates from gws-chat by excluding Chat messages.

gws-keep.description: Google Keep: creates, reads, lists, and deletes notes; downloads note attachments; adds and removes collaborators. Use for sticky notes, quick jottings, or sharing a note.
gws-keep.rationale: Leads with the distinctive Keep nouns (notes, sticky notes, jottings) and names every API method's CRUD verb plus attachments and collaborators, staying clear of Tasks' to-do/checklist territory.

gws-meet.description: Google Meet: creates, updates, and ends Meet spaces (meeting rooms); fetches conference recordings, transcripts, participants, and smart notes. Use for Meet rooms — not Calendar events.
gws-meet.rationale: Leads with Meet space CRUD and the distinctive recording/transcript/participant/smart-notes nouns, and explicitly disambiguates from Calendar events.

gws-modelarmor.description: Model Armor: creates, updates, deletes AI safety templates; sanitizes LLM prompts and filters model responses. Use for AI guardrails, content moderation, or prompt screening.
gws-modelarmor.rationale: Leads with Model Armor's distinctive safety-template CRUD plus prompt/response sanitization, and triggers on guardrail/moderation/screening intent without colliding with other gws services.

gws-people.description: Google Contacts: adds, finds, edits, deletes contacts and contact groups — phone numbers, emails, addresses; searches the directory. Use for contact details, not email.
gws-people.rationale: Front-loads contact/contact-group CRUD plus directory search with the distinctive nouns (phone numbers, addresses) a real user types, while disambiguating from Gmail by noting "contact details, not email."

gws-script.description: Apps Script: pushes .gs files, creates projects, runs functions, edits project code, manages deployments and versions. Use for Apps Script automation extending Sheets, Docs, or Gmail.
gws-script.rationale: Leads with the distinctive "Apps Script"/".gs files" nouns and names create/run/edit-code/deploy/version CRUD plus the push helper, while the "extending Sheets, Docs, Gmail" boundary avoids colliding with those services.

gws-shared.description: gws-shared: internal library providing OAuth auth, --format/--dry-run/--sanitize flags, and output formatting for all gws-* skills. Not directly user-invoked.
gws-shared.rationale: Frames the skill as the internal shared dependency (auth, flags, formatting) with no user-facing nouns or verbs, signaling the model to route real requests to the specific gws-* service skills instead.

gws-sheets.description: Google Sheets: reads ranges, appends rows, edits cells, creates spreadsheets, and updates sheet tabs. Use for spreadsheet values, rows, cells, or tabs.
gws-sheets.rationale: Leads with Sheets-specific nouns (ranges, rows, cells, spreadsheets, tabs) covering required append/read plus create and update CRUD, distinct from Docs/Slides.

gws-slides.description: Google Slides: creates, reads, edits, and batch-updates presentations, slides, text, and shapes. Use for slide decks or presentations — not Docs or Sheets.
gws-slides.rationale: Leads with distinctive deck/presentation/slide nouns and names all four API operations while drawing a clear boundary against Docs and Sheets.

gws-tasks.description: Google Tasks: creates, lists, completes, updates, deletes, moves, and clears to-dos and task lists. Use for checklists, marking items done, or reordering personal tasks.
gws-tasks.rationale: Leads with the distinctive Tasks nouns (to-dos, task lists, checklists) and names every CRUD plus move/clear/complete operation while staying clear of Calendar or Keep triggers.

gws-workflow.description: Workspace cross-service workflows: standup report, meeting prep, weekly digest, email-to-task, Drive-to-Chat announce. Use when a task spans Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, Drive, or Chat.
gws-workflow.rationale: Leads with the named multi-step workflows and the cross-service trigger condition so it fires only when a request genuinely spans Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, Drive, or Chat together, leaving single-service requests to their specific gws-* skill.
